current_evidence: Not verified: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 (the shared fetch budget was used up). A site-restricted search found Grokbot's page ('Guidance on completing a planning application', in the householders section) and a separate developers page, 'What to submit for a developers planning application' (/planning-applications/developers-making-planning-application/what-submit). Either could hold the local list, but neither could be read or dated.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured no requirements for this council. tab_items is empty, Req. items is 0, and all 18 application-type rows say '(none) - Not covered: local list link found but not readable'. The Status is 'Link only (not readable)' even though 'Docs read' is 5, so the five documents it opened gave no requirements.
issues.evidence: reference_row Status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)'; Req. items '0'; Docs read '5'

issues.detail: The List date 2015-03-01 comes from 'PDF metadata CreationDate', not from text in a document. The linked validation URL is an HTML page, not a PDF. The only PDF in docs_read is the printed democratic decision 'Introduction of Local Validation List for Planning Applications' (decision 2194), which records the decision and is not the list itself. So the date is neither a stated adoption date nor the date of the linked list.
issues.evidence: reference_row Date basis 'PDF metadata CreationDate'; docs_read '.../d2194/Printed%20decision%20Introduction%20of%20Local%20Validation%20List%20for%20Planning%20Applications.pdf'

issues.detail: The validation link is a page in the householders section ('householders-making-planning/guidance-completing-planning-application'), so it may cover householder applications only. The council also has a separate developers page, 'What to submit for a developers planning application', which a search returned for 'local validation list' and which Grokbot neither linked nor read. Full, outline and other non-householder requirements are probably not covered by Grokbot's link. This is unverified because the fetch budget had run out.
issues.evidence: WebSearch (bracknell-forest.gov.uk): 'What to submit for a developers planning application' and 'Guidance on completing a planning application'

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' field points to a democratic-services decision record (ieDecisionDetails.aspx?Id=2194), not the council's planning or validation web page. Also, 'Outdated (>2y)?' is blank although the recorded List date (2015) is more than ten years old.

summary: Grokbot's row has no requirements. Its 2015 date comes from the file metadata of a council decision PDF, not from the list, and its link is a page in the householders section, while a separate developers 'What to submit' page also exists. The audit could not read either page because the shared web fetch and search budgets ran out, so it is still unknown which list is current and what it contains.
